record.one_liner: Gumroad provides a REST API supporting OAuth2 and bearer tokens for managing products and interacting with user accounts.

auth_methods.quote: Your access token is used in the request header of every request to the API and should be kept secret, like a password.

access_test.quote: First, sign in to your Gumroad account. Then, go to advanced settings . Here, you'll see a form to create a new application.

access_ship.quote: To create an application for general use, you'll need to build a Redirect URI handler to generate access tokens for each of your users.

api_breadth.quote: With your access token in hand, head back to our API documentation for a list of endpoints the API makes available.

official_mcp.quote: Create an application for the API - Gumroad Help Center Create an application for the API In this article: For just your Gumroad account Generating an access token For any Gumroad account Sign in with Gumroad Using a Redirect URI Enabling your application

auth_methods.reason: The page documents an OAuth2 authorization code flow and states the token returned is of type 'Bearer' to be used in request headers.

access_test.reason: The page states that any signed-in user can immediately create an application and generate access tokens via advanced settings.

access_ship.reason: The page shows that building an application for any Gumroad account uses the same self-serve application creation process without requiring manual review or paid plans.

api_type.reason: The page demonstrates HTTP REST endpoints such as `GET https://api.gumroad.com/v2/products`.

api_breadth.reason: The page mentions referring back to API documentation for a list of endpoints but does not list or summarize them to determine breadth.

official_mcp.reason: The page makes no mention of Model Context Protocol (MCP) or an official MCP server.
